Dev.releaseNotes:
`feat` (`webui`): **Serve a web UI per host, and trust forwarded headers from listed proxies**:

- Added host overrides (`WebUIServiceSettings.HostOverrides`, `WebUIHostOverride`): a host, with an optional port, mapped to a web UI; the selected web UI stays the default for every other host
- Served each host its own web UI, mount path and redirects, and installed the bundled release of every web UI in use
- Answered `/api/v3/WebUI` and its release routes for the request's host; `PATCH /api/v3/WebUI/Provider` takes the overrides
- Added `Web.TrustedProxies` (`SHOKO_TRUSTED_PROXIES`): forwarded headers are honoured only from the listed proxies, as the first step of the pipeline
- `IWebUIService` gained per-host lookups and the overrides; its release methods take the web UI they are for

`fix` (`config`): **Require a key on a list of rows that is drawn inline by default**:

- Checked an automatic list of class items as an inline one: its rows need a `[Key]` member or a `TitleComponent`
- Named the property in the error
- Keyed `AiringTrackPreference.Kind` and `MetadataProviderAssignment.ProviderID`, which lacked one

`fix`: **Skip types that cannot load when scanning the loaded assemblies**:

- Added `ReflectionUtils.ScannableTypes` and `LoadableTypes`, used by every scan of the loaded assemblies
- A plugin the server refused could leave a type whose dependency is missing, and `GetTypes()` then stopped the start with no web server up

`feat` (`buildtools`): **Detect a meta plugin and stamp it as `PackageIsMeta`**:

- Added `DetectMetaPlugin`, run before `CoreCompile` under `shoko-build` too
- Stamped `true` when the project sets `PluginGenerateClass` and has no `Compile` item outside its intermediate folder, else `false`

`feat` (`plugin`): **Read `PackageIsMeta` into `IsMeta`**:

- Added `IsMeta` to `LocalPluginInfo` and the APIv3 `PluginInfo`, `null` when unmarked
- Read the manifest's `is_meta`, on the package and on each release, into `PackageManifestInfo.IsMeta`, `PackageReleaseInfo.IsMeta` and their APIv3 models

`feat` (`buildtools`): **Record `is_meta` on the release entry and the manifest in `shoko-build`**:

- Read `PackageIsMeta` from the built assembly and wrote it to the release entry
- Set the manifest's `is_meta` to `true` when every release is a meta plugin, `false` when any is not, and left it out otherwise
- Added both to `manifest.schema.json`

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.117**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools targets version to v0.7.2**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.8.2**.

`fix` (`buildtools`): **Write a generated file only when its text changes**:

- Left an unchanged plugin's generated sources alone, so it is no longer recompiled on every build

`fix` (`buildtools`): **Hand the plugin namespace to the build as `PluginNamespace`**:

- Passed the namespace from `--namespace`, the project or the manifest to targets that read the property

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools targets version to v0.7.1**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.8.1**.

`fix` (`api`): **Name generic schemas with `Of`, `And` and `End`**:

- Named generics from their type arguments, not the type's string form, which garbled generics with more than one argument
- Replaced `ListResult_…_` with `ListResultOf…`, closing an argument with `End` only when another follows
`fix` (`plugin`): **Keep a plugin's namespace once it is created**.

`feat` (`buildtools`): **Stamp a plugin namespace from `PluginNamespace` or the manifest**:

- Read `PluginNamespace`, else the manifest's `namespace`, and stamp it as `PackageNamespace`
- Stopped the build on a namespace that is not 2 to 32 characters of kebab-case, or is `shoko`, `core` or `plugin`

`feat` (`buildtools`): **Stamp and record the plugin namespace in `shoko-build`**:

- Took `--namespace`, `PluginNamespace` or the manifest's `namespace`, checked it and stamped it as `PackageNamespace`
- Wrote a stated namespace into the manifest, and added `namespace` to `manifest.schema.json`

`feat` (`plugin`): **Read the plugin namespace and fail plugins that break it or share it**:

- Read `PackageNamespace` into `LocalPluginInfo.Namespace` and the APIv3 `PluginInfo`
- Failed a plugin whose namespace is not kebab-case of 2 to 32 characters, or is `shoko`, `core` or `plugin`
- Failed every loaded plugin claiming the namespace of another, naming the others

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools targets version to v0.7.0**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.8.0**.

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.116**.

`fix` (`api`): **Leave the system's own mount points out of `/api/v3/Folder/MountPoints`**:

- Matched the formats .NET reports today (`cgroup2`, `bpf`, `pstore`, `devtmpfs`, `autofs`, `efivarfs`, the desktop's `fuse.portal` and `fuse.gvfsd-fuse`), keeping the older names
- Left out `/proc`, `/sys`, `/dev`, `/boot` and `/efi` by path, so FAT drives elsewhere still list
- Dropped duplicate paths

`docs`: **Put every websocket under `/signalr`, whatever it speaks**: (_Skip CI_)

- A plugin's sockets go under `/signalr/plugin/<namespace>/`, SignalR or not, since that is the path proxies upgrade
- Plain HTTP routes stay under `/api`; `EnableSignalR` only mounts the core's own hubs

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Let a code editor name its script kind and definitions file**:

- Added `ScriptKind` (`script`, `module` or `function-body`) and `DefinitionsPath` to `CodeEditorAttribute` and `UiCodeEditorElement`
- Both follow the editor's language: `DefinitionsPath` names a `.d.ts`, JSON Schema, Lua definitions or XML Schema served by the plugin, and data languages ignore `ScriptKind`

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.115**.

`fix` (`abstractions`): **Leave the key out of an `ApiToken` written as text**:

- `ApiToken` writes its user, device and expiry for `ToString`, never `Token`, so a token in a log or a message carries no key

`fix` (`api`): **Send a browser's unanswered page into the web UI**:

- A page outside the mount path that the rest of the pipeline answers `404` is redirected to the same path under it
- Until the server has started, such a page is redirected at once, as the not-running check would answer it
- Requests not accepting `text/html` and the `/api`, `/plugin` and `/signalr` paths keep their answers

`fix` (`buildtools`): **Leave the plugin metadata to `shoko-build` when it drives the build**:

- The targets stamped identity, tags, dependencies and git data a second time, and the server kept their tags, without the discovered ones

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools targets version to v0.6.1**.

`fix`: **Keep release dependencies when syncing package repositories**:

The sync dropped each release's `dependencies` when converting a repository manifest, so no package ever carried them and installs never saw them.

`feat`: **Install plugin dependencies with their dependents**:

- Planned installs (`PlanInstall`) pull in missing dependencies, all or nothing (`InstallPackages`)
- Versions installed as dependencies carry a `.dependency` marker and are enabled while something needs them
- Orphaned dependencies can be listed and uninstalled
- Upgrades respect dependents' version ranges and plan new dependencies
- `ValidateEnable` looks at the next start, so a dependency enabled on demand counts

`feat` (`api`): **Plan installs and manage plugins installed as dependencies**:

- `GET /api/v3/Plugin/Package/{packageID}/Install` returns the install plan; the `POST` installs it, dependencies included by default, and answers a plain `424` when they cannot be met
- `IsDependency` on plugin versions, settable like `IsPinned`, plus `IsEnabledOnDemand`
- `GET`/`DELETE /api/v3/Plugin/Orphans`, and uninstalling removes the orphans it leaves unless `keepOrphans` is set
- Release dependencies shown on package releases

`feat`: **Generate plugin classes and embed plugin images from the project**:

- `PluginGenerateClass` has `Shoko.BuildTools.Targets` write the plugin's `IPlugin` class: a partial `<RootNamespace>.Plugin` reading the stamped identity, extended by the plugin's own partial; with no other code it is a meta plugin
- `PluginIcon` and `PluginThumbnail` embed the plugin's images under stamped names, which the server reads before `EmbeddedIconResourceName` and `EmbeddedThumbnailResourceName`

`feat` (`buildtools`): **Write the project's plugin identity into the manifest**:

`shoko-build` now writes the name, overview and tags the project states into the manifest it updates, so the project is the truth and the published manifest follows it. A mismatched `id` still stops the build.

`refactor` (`plugin`): **Generate the legacy Plex plugin's class from its project**:

- Moved its identity and images into the project
- Bumped `Shoko.BuildTools.Targets` to v0.6.0

`refactor`: **Serve the web UI through web UI providers**:

- Added `IWebUIProvider` and `IWebUIService`, so a plugin can take over serving the web UI; the Shoko Web UI became `CoreWebUIProvider`
- Moved the web component members off `ISystemUpdateService`
- Served the active web UI after routing, so mapped routes always win
- Removed `/api/v3/WebUI/Update/ReportManualUpdate`
- Removed the `Web.WebUIPrefix`, `Web.WebUIPath` and `Web.EnableIndexRedirect` settings and `IApplicationPaths.WebPath`; the Shoko Web UI is always at `/webui`, from `webui` in the data folder
- Moved `Web.EnableWebUI` to the web UI service's own `IsEnabled`

`feat` (`api`): **Expose the active web UI and the provider selection under `/api/v3/WebUI`**:

- `GET /api/v3/WebUI` answers anonymously with the active web UI's mount path, link templates and release
- `GET`/`PATCH /api/v3/WebUI/Provider` list the web UIs and pick the one served after the next start
- Added `MaximumServerVersion`, `IsBundled` and `IncompatibleReason` to web UI releases

`refactor`: **Split `PluginManager` into partial files**:

- Moved the scan, loading, failures, info and management code out of `PluginManager.cs` into partials of their own, unchanged
- Moved the dependency graph into `PluginManager.Dependencies.cs`

`feat`: **Tell which release and relocation providers can be used now**:

- Added `IsConfigured` and `NotConfiguredReason` to `IReleaseInfoProvider` and `IRelocationProvider`
- Added `GetAvailability` to the release and relocation services and `ISuspensionService.GetHolding`, giving a `ProviderAvailability`
- Release searches and relocation pass by or refuse a provider that is not configured or held by a suspension; queued jobs still wait
- The AniDB release provider is not configured without credentials, and the `AniDB UDP` suspension holds it
- Showed the availability on the APIv3 release and relocation provider models

`fix` (`workflows`): **Pass the plugin bundling flags before the pwsh comment on Windows**:

pwsh treated everything after `# %2c is comma…` as a comment, so the Windows tray builds and the installer never set `ShokoBundleReleasedPlugins` and shipped without the released plugins.

`feat` (`plugin`): **Load each plugin into a load context of its own**:

- Added `PluginLoadContext`: the server's assemblies stay shared, a dependency's own projects come from the dependency, and the packages a plugin ships are its own
- Plugins can now ship different versions of the same library
- A plugin built against a newer copy of a package the server ships uses its own copy, unless the package is part of the framework or the plugin contract

`refactor`: **Let release and airing schedule providers limit their jobs**:

- Added `MaxConcurrentJobs` to `IReleaseInfoProvider`, applied to its generic job
- Replaced `IAiringScheduleProvider.MaxConcurrentRefreshes` with `MaxConcurrentJobs`, applied to its refresh job instead of a semaphore

`chore` (`queue`): **Spell `facade` without a cedilla**.

`refactor` (`queue`): **Cap provided limits inside the default pool**:

- An `IJobConcurrencyProvider` limit no longer opens a pool of its own
- The admin's overrides lower a provided limit too

`feat`: **Let plugins hand out scheduled actions while the server runs**:

- Added `IScheduledActionProvider`, keyed actions with IDs from the provider and key
- Added `IScheduledActionService.ActionsChanged` and `Providers`, and the `action:actions.changed` feed event
- An added action counts from when it was added; a removed one loses its row
- Schedule rows keep their plugin, so an uninstall with data and a start-up sweep of month-old rows remove them

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools targets version to v0.6.0**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.7.0**.

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.114**.

`chore` (`queue`): **Bump `Shoko.QueueProcessor` to `6.0.0-alpha.15`**.

`fix` (`workflows`): **Pin the .NET SDK to `10.0.402`**:

- The `aka.ms` links of `10.0.403` lead to storage that refuses downloads, so `10.x` fails to install; revert once they work

`revert`: **Unpin the .NET SDK**:

- The `aka.ms` links of `10.0.403` work again, so the workflows take `10.x` once more

`fix`: **Raise `ManagedFolderUpdated` when a managed folder is updated**:

- `UpdateManagedFolder` changed the cached folder in place, so the save
  compared it with itself and never announced the change
- The added and updated events carry the saved folder, so an added one
  has its ID

`fix` (`queue`): **Raise the paused and started events from `IQueueScheduler`**.

`fix` (`anidb`): **Key the AVDump of video files by the video, not the file location**.

`fix`: **Let custom tags keep their name on update, and delete them once**:

- `UpdateCustomTag` took the tag's own name for a duplicate
- `DeleteCustomTag` deleted the cross-references the repository had
  already deleted with the tag
- `DELETE /api/v3/Tag/User/{tagID}` goes through `DeleteCustomTag`

`fix` (`api`): **Find the release group in `GET /api/v3/AniDB/ReleaseGroup/{groupID}`**.

`fix` (`api`): **Read the episode's own user data for the `includeVoted` filter**.

`fix`: **Sort the series with release candidates before paging them**.

`fix` (`api`): **Save the settings the APIv2 setters change**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Look up releases by URI and by hash through `IVideoReleaseService`**:

- `GetReleasesByURI`, `GetReleaseByHashAndSize` and `GetVideoForRelease`
  read what the repository already indexes; several videos can share a
  release URI, so the first gives them all

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IMetadataService.GetMissingShokoEpisodes`**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IVideoService.GetUnrecognizedVideos`**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Raise events for custom tags and their series links**:

- `CustomTagAdded`, `CustomTagUpdated` (with the previous name and
  overview) and `CustomTagRemoved`
- `SeriesCustomTagsChanged` when tags are added to or removed from a
  series

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IMetadataLinkingService.AutoLinkingChanged`**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Raise added, updated and removed events for collections**:

- The collection store raises them when it writes or removes a
  collection, and image changes raise `CollectionUpdated`, as for movies
- A Shoko group's own events are forwarded as collection events too,
  its image changes included
- The `metadata` feed forwards them as `collection.added`,
  `collection.updated` and `collection.removed`, leaving groups to the
  `group` feed

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Raise stored, updated and deleted events for filter presets**:

- `FilterPresetRepository` raises them on every save and delete, so the
  API's writes are covered too, and `IFilterPresetManager` forwards them
  with the actor

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IMetadataService.DeleteShokoSeries`**:

- Deletes one series as `DELETE /api/v3/Series/{seriesID}` does, which
  now goes through it, optionally with its files and the AniDB anime

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IScheduledActionService.TriggersChanged`**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Look up release groups through `IVideoReleaseService`**.

`fix`: **Treat a release with any field changed as a new release**:

- The "exactly the same" check compared hash codes built from the list
  items' references, so it never matched; it compares the stored
  columns now, `IsPublic` and `PreventRescan` included
- `PreventRescan` is plain release data: a save no longer ORs it with
  the stored value
- `PATCH /api/v3/File/{fileID}/Release` is gone; a flag changes by
  saving the release through `POST /api/v3/ReleaseInfo/File/{fileID}`

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Say what the missing episode counts of `IShokoSeries` count**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Stamp the actor on the group events**:

- `GroupInfoUpdatedEventArgs` and `SeriesMovedEventArgs` carry `Actor`
- `GroupsRecreated` carries the new `GroupsRecreatedEventArgs` for it

`docs` (`abstractions`): **List every event that carries the actor**.

`fix` (`api`): **Route the APIv2 file and group watch routes and the series links again**:

- `file/watch`, `file/unwatch` and `group/unwatch` were private and
  `links/serie` static, so MVC never mapped them

`refactor` (`api`): **Hide episodes through `IMetadataOrderingService`**:

- `POST /api/v3/Episode/{episodeID}/SetHidden` calls `SetEpisodeHidden`,
  which always updates the series and group stats of a Shoko episode,
  so the route's `updateStats` option is gone

`refactor` (`api`): **Rehash files through `IVideoHashingService`**:

- The APIv3 file and series rehash routes and the APIv2 `rehash`,
  `rehashunlinked` and `rehashmanuallinks` call
  `ScheduleGetHashesForFile` instead of queueing `HashFileJob`
- A file gone from disk answers as a missing file, or is skipped in the
  bulk routes

`refactor` (`api`): **Scan a managed folder through `IVideoService`**:

- `GET /api/v3/ManagedFolder/{folderID}/Scan` calls
  `ScheduleScanForManagedFolder`, so its clean-up and file size check
  follow the import settings as every other scan does

`refactor` (`api`): **Write filter presets through `IFilterPresetManager`**:

- The `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` routes of `/api/v3/Filter`
  create, update and delete through the manager after the API's own
  checks, instead of saving a changed cached preset
- A stored filter can no longer become a directory filter or stop being
  one through `PUT` or `PATCH`

`fix` (`relocation`): **Raise `PresetUpdated` for both presets when the default changes**:

- The preset losing the default flag was saved without an event, and a
  preset made the default without other changes raised none either

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IPluginPackageManager.RepositoryStaleTimeOnStart`**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IAnidbService.TestLogin`**:

- `POST /api/v3/Settings/AniDB/TestLogin` goes through it

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Read AVDump state and queue dumps with a priority through `IAnidbAvdumpService`**:

- `IsAvdumpConfigured`, `GetActiveSessions`, `GetSessionForVideo` and
  `GetAvdumpInfo`, with sessions as `IAnidbAvdumpSession`
- `ScheduleAvdumpVideos` and `ScheduleAvdumpVideoFiles` take a
  `prioritize` overload
- The AVDump status, update and dump routes go through the service; a
  dump run now still waits for the dump to finish

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Expose `IsStub` on creators, characters, studios and networks**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **List the AniDB title dump and look up AniDB tags by ID**:

- `IAnidbService.SearchAnime` with an empty or blank query lists every
  entry of the title dump by AniDB anime ID, as the API's search does
- `IAnidbService.GetTagByID`

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `ISystemService.IsInUse`**:

- Counts stream sessions sending data as well as recent file streams;
  `GET /api/v3/Init/InUse` and APIv2 `init/inuse` read it

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Raise events for orderings, preferred orderings and hidden episodes**:

- `OrderingAdded`, `OrderingUpdated` and `OrderingRemoved` on
  `IMetadataOrderingService`, global and local orderings alike
- `PreferredOrderingChanged`, also when removing the chosen ordering
  forgets it
- `EpisodeHiddenChanged` for an episode of any source

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Raise saved and changed events from the people, studio and tag stores**:

- `EntitiesSaved` on `IMetadataPeopleStore` and `IMetadataStudioStore`,
  the studio store's link stubs included
- `StudiosChanged` and `NetworksChanged` on `IMetadataStudioStore` when
  an entry's links change
- `EntitiesRemoved` on `IMetadataTagStore` for the purge of unused tags

`feat` (`abstractions`): **List the creators and characters of a source**:

- `IMetadataPeopleStore.GetAllCreators` and `GetAllCharacters`, for
  `anidb` and plugin sources, stubs included
- `IMetadataService.GetAllCreatorsForSource` and
  `GetAllCharactersForSource` read them

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IMetadataTextManager.SetCustomTitle` and `SetCustomOverview`**:

- Sugar for naming or describing a Shoko series or episode by hand, with
  the series saved and the updated event raised as the API did
- The series and episode title override routes go through it

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IUserDataService.UpdateWatchedStats`**:

- Recomputes the watched stats of a series or group, for one user or
  all, so a batch of writes can flush once at the end
- Renamed the internal helpers to `UpdateSeriesWatchedStats` and
  `UpdateGroupWatchedStats`

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IScheduledActionService.RunStarted` and `RunCompleted`**:

- Raised by the run's queue job once the action agreed to run, and when
  it ends, with what it threw and the actor who queued it

`refactor`: **List and purge missing files through `IVideoService`**:

- Added `GetVideosWithMissingFiles`, the videos with a file gone from
  disk (or only those with nothing left)
- Moved the "Remove Missing Files" routine from `ActionService` into
  `IVideoService.RemoveMissingVideoFiles`, which the scheduled action,
  its job and the legacy routes now call

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add next-up and active episodes to `IUserDataService`**:

- `GetActiveEpisode`, `GetNextUpEpisode` and `GetNextUpEpisodes`, with
  `NextUpOptions`, on the rules the dashboard and playlists use
- `GetNextUpEpisodes` now keeps `DisableFirstEpisode` when given it

`feat` (`config`): **Allow `MetadataGuid` dictionary keys in configurations**:

- `ShokoJsonSchemaGenerator` takes `MetadataGuid` as a key, like `MetadataSource` and `MetadataEntityType`
- SHOKO0002 no longer reports any of the three

`refactor` (`api`): **Drop the no-op group stats update from the TMDB show link routes**.

`fix`: **Raise `ApiTokenInvalidated` for the duplicate tokens a new token drops**:

- `GenerateApiTokenForUser` removed the other permanent tokens of the
  device without telling anyone

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IAnidbService.GetComputedStartSeason`**:

- The start season the rule gives, leaving out any override; the
  APIv3 start season routes now read it from there

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IImageManager.TemplateUrlChanged`**:

- Raised when `SetTemplateUrlForSource` changes the user's own template
  URL for a source, with the actor

`fix` (`plugin`): **Prefer the bundled copy of a plugin version and drop installed copies of it**:

- On a tie between equal versions, the copy the server ships loads
- At start, an installed copy of a version the server ships is removed
  unless it is pinned or kept, so an upgrade the next server release
  ships too no longer stays beside it

`feat` (`plugin`): **Add a setting to leave bundled plugins out of the automatic upgrades**:

- `Plugins.Updates.SkipBundledPluginUpgrades`, off by default, on
  `IPluginPackageManager` and the APIv3 package settings
- Upgrades on start and while running skip the plugins the server ships;
  installing by hand still works

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IMetadataTextManager.ExplainChoice`**:

- Says which step of the chooser picked an entry's title or overview,
  as a `TextChoiceInfo`; `TextChoiceStep` moved to the abstractions
- The APIv3 preferred text route reads it instead of downcasting

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IMetadataOrderingService.GetGroupEntries`**:

- Lists a group of an ordering in one call, placed specials and where
  they air included, as `OrderingGroupEntry`
- The APIv3 ordering model reads the same listing

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IAiringScheduleService.GetChannelsByName`**:

- Every channel answering to a name or alias, in every country, read
  from an index; the APIv3 by-name route uses it instead of a full scan

`fix`: **Raise `VideoFileDeleted` for the duplicate file records the missing file purge removes**.

`feat` (`api`): **Forward the new events to the SignalR feeds**:

- `metadata`: custom tags, series custom tags, auto-linking, orderings
  and hidden episodes, to the users who may see the series
- `user`: API tokens created and removed, to their owner and the admins
- New `filter` feed for filter presets, and the admin-only `relocation`
  and `action` feeds for relocation presets and scheduled actions

`refactor`: **Use primary constructors where a constructor only assigned its parameters**:

- Covers the event args, services, APIv3 controllers and models this
  series touched; APIv2 is left alone
- Dropped the unread `IPluginPackageManager` from `ActionService`

`chore` (`queue`): **Bump `Shoko.QueueProcessor` to `6.0.0-alpha.14`**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools analyzers version to v0.2.0**.

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.113**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IVideoService.SetVideoVariation`**:

- Plugins can mark a video as a variation, or unmark it
- `PUT /api/v3/File/{fileID}/Variation` goes through it, as the video
  action will

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IVideoService.SetVideoIgnored`**:

- Plugins can mark a video as ignored, or unmark it
- `PUT /api/v3/File/{fileID}/Ignore` goes through it, as the video
  action will

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IVideoService.GetIgnoredVideos`**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Add `IVideoService.VideoUpdated`**:

- Raised by `SetVideoIgnored` and `SetVideoVariation` when a flag
  changes, with the actor
- "Check for Previously Ignored Files" goes through `SetVideoIgnored`,
  so its changes raise it too
- The `file` feed forwards it as `file:updated`

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.112**.

`fix` (`filters`): **Treat a filter where nothing takes part as no filter**:

- A filter whose expression didn't take part, such as one of only switches set to keep everything, matched nothing; it now matches everything

`docs` (`filters`): **Reword the help of the `And`, `Or`, `Xor` and `Not` gates**.

`refactor` (`filters`): **Make the switch three-way on `InclusionFilter`, label first**:

- `SwitchExpression` keeps only (`Only`) or leaves out (`False`) what its condition matches; set to keep everything (`True`) or left unset, it is left out of the filter
- Its label moved to `Parameter`, as a group's, and the inclusion to `SecondParameter`, offered as the `InclusionFilter` names
- Dropped the switch from the stored-shape migration, as nothing had stored one yet

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.111**.

`feat` (`api`): **Add filter count endpoints**:

- `POST /api/v3/Filter/Preview/Count` and `GET /api/v3/Filter/{filterID}/Count` answer `{ Groups, Series }`, counted as the matching group and series listings would list them, without building the list items
- The listings and the counts share the same filtering helpers in `FilterController`

`refactor` (`filters`): **Store every filter expression's values as `Parameter` and `SecondParameter`**:

- A contract resolver stores each expression by its container members, so the classes naming their values themselves (`InSeason`, `InYear`, `Switch`, the character and creator ones) no longer get keys of their own
- A schema step moves the old keys of stored presets over, a season, appearance or role becoming its name and a removed one unset

`fix` (`core`): **Apply `Import.Exclude` patterns to directories** ([#1464](https://github.com/ShokoAnime/ShokoServer/pull/1464)):

**What**:

`CoreIgnoreRule.ShouldIgnore` returned `false` for every entry that is not a `FileInfo`, so `Import.ExcludeExpressions` never matched a folder — even though scans pass directories to ignore rules and the walker prunes a rejected directory together with its whole subtree (`FileSystemHelpers.GetFileSystemEntryPaths`, the `canProceed(directory, true)` branch).

That made the documented contract unreachable. A pattern like `[\/]!SomeTree[\/]` filtered the *files* inside that tree, but the walk still enumerated it — the expensive part — and every nested directory with a plugin rule was still descended into.

**Changes**:

- The rule now matches directories as well as files; the file path is untouched.
- A directory path gets the platform separator appended before a single pass over the patterns. `DirectoryInfo.FullName` never ends with a separator, so a pattern written as a directory prefix (the shipped defaults are `[\\/]\.Trash-\d+[\\/]`) matched only the children and pruned one level too late.
- `Shoko.Abstractions/Video/README.md` no longer claims the built-in rule is file-only.
